name: Fahey/Klein Gallery
about_text: Fahey/Klein Gallery is a Los Angeles photography gallery founded in 1986 by David Fahey and Randee Klein Devlin. Ken Devlin joined as co-owner in 1998; David Fahey has led the gallery since 2016. Located on North La Brea Avenue, the gallery specializes in 20th-century and contemporary fine art photography, with an inventory of more than 8,000 prints spanning portraiture, nudes, landscapes, still life, reportage and documentary work. Its exhibition program has featured photographers from Edward Weston and Man Ray to Herb Ritts and James Nachtwey, and the gallery mounts new two-person shows roughly every five weeks. Staff also curate touring exhibitions for museums and galleries abroad, contribute to photography publications, and maintain an active secondary-market and private-collection advisory practice.
